value.rationale: The degree spectrum is a natural information-theoretic invariant of two-read ambiguity, needed for degree-sensitive graph estimates; its exact recursion and explicit variance quantify deviations invisible to the known average edge count. The all-length Gaussian normalization and exact coefficient describe a different question from already-solved pairwise maximum intersection bounds; the result is not a parameter substitution or finite sample census.
